skill1.description: When performing a Challenge, you fail by drawing the 5th card that doesn't match the Suit, instead of the 4th.
skill1.name: Jack of All Trades

skill2.description: Once per mission, another player can discard their hand to prevent you from taking Damage. At least one card must be discarded for this to happen.
skill2.name: Collect a Debt

skill3.description: Once per campaign, turn a Failure obtained in one of your Challenges into a Success. You still lose all cards drawn during the Challenge, as in a Failure.
skill3.name: By a Hair

skill4.description: Three times per mission, successfully Helping another player reduces the Difficulty Level by 2 instead of 1.
skill4.name: Teamwork

skill5.description: Permanently increase one of your Personal Modifiers by 1, then immediately gain 2 new Skills that don't reduce your Personal Modifiers.
skill5.name: Pay the Price

skill6.description: Once per mission, you can place the first card of the deck in the Lost Opportunities Pile to obtain a Triumph in a Challenge. Characters can still take Damage. This Skill cannot be used against Targets.
skill6.name: Crazy Enough to Work

skill7.description: When you draw the first card of a Challenge, draw two, keep one and Discard the other. The discarded card has no effect on the Challenge.
skill7.name: Just in Case

clubs.description: Once per mission, you can intimidate an NPC who is not a Target without performing a Challenge.
clubs.name: Imposing

hearts.description: You can never take Damage or Face Destiny in a Hearts (♥) Challenge.
hearts.name: Lovable

spades.description: At the beginning of each session, take an Ace of your choice from the deck and Steal it, then reshuffle the deck.
spades.name: Change of Strategy

skill1.description: When you get a Critical Success in a Challenge, you can Steal up to two Number Cards used in the Challenge.
skill1.name: A Little Extra

skill2.description: When you get a Failure in a Challenge, you can Steal a Number Card used in the Challenge.
skill2.name: Consolation Prize

skill3.description: At the beginning of each mission, draw from the deck until you find two Number Cards and Steal them, then reshuffle the deck.
skill3.name: Well-Laid Plans

skill4.description: When you use your Instrument, your worst Personal Modifier becomes 0. If it's already 0, it becomes -1.
skill4.name: The Right Touch

skill5.description: You can conceal weapons or instruments that would normally be too large to be Concealed (if it makes sense).
skill5.name: Hidden Compartment

skill6.description: At the beginning of each mission, you can choose an additional weapon or instrument of any size that has been hidden in the area where the Target is located.
skill6.name: Always Prepared

skill7.description: For the rest of the campaign, you cannot Help or be Helped by any other player. Permanently reduce one of your Personal Modifiers by 1, down to a maximum of -2.
skill7.name: You're in My Way

clubs.description: You can play 5 cards from your hand to obtain a Critical Success in your current Challenge. You cannot use this Skill against a Target.
clubs.name: All In

hearts.description: At the beginning of each mission, create an NPC together with the GM. You can encounter them during the mission and they owe you a favor.
hearts.name: Infiltrators

spades.description: After performing a Challenge, regardless of the result, roll for any cards you played from your hand (as if you had Retreated). Instead of discarding them, take them back into your hand.
spades.name: High Stakes

clubs.description: Permanently reduce your Clubs personal modifier by 1, up to a maximum of -2.
clubs.name: A Bit More Muscle

hearts.description: Permanently reduce your Hearts personal modifier by 1, up to a maximum of -2.
hearts.name: A Bit More Brain

spades.description: Permanently reduce your Spades personal modifier by 1, up to a maximum of -2.
spades.name: A Bit More Balance

skill1.description: When you get a Failure in a Challenge, you can discard a Face Card used in the Challenge and place the other cards in the Lost Opportunities Pile, or vice versa.
skill1.name: Sacrifice

skill2.description: When you Retreat from a Challenge, treat all cards you roll for as if their value were 2 higher.
skill2.name: Not Today

skill3.description: Three times per mission, you can Help another player without performing a Challenge.
skill3.name: Reliable

skill4.description: Once per mission, you can take the first three Number Cards from the Discard Pile and place them in the Lost Opportunities Pile to avoid taking Damage.
skill4.name: Shield

skill5.description: Three times per mission, if no one offers you their Help, you can reduce the Difficulty Level of a Challenge by 1.
skill5.name: I Can Handle Myself

skill6.description: Three times per mission, you can Steal a Number Card that would be lost during a Challenge in which a player has Retreated. You can only play these cards during other players' Challenges.
skill6.name: In Reserve

skill7.description: Three times per mission, you can look at the first card of the deck during another player's Challenge and reveal what card it is.
skill7.name: Clairvoyant

clubs.description: At any moment, you can choose to take Damage in place of another Character.
clubs.name: In Your Place

hearts.description: Twice per mission, you can command an NPC to do something for you without performing a Challenge. You cannot use this Skill against a Target.
hearts.name: Commanding Aura

spades.description: At the beginning of each mission, after everyone else has triggered their start-of-mission Skills, search the deck for your Face Card, shuffle the deck, and place your Face Card on top.
spades.name: Shortcut

genreDescriptions.chanbara: Samurai drama, ronin honor, and feudal political intrigue.
genreDescriptions.conspiracy: Espionage, secret societies, and truths hidden in plain sight.
genreDescriptions.cosmicHorror: Unknowable eldritch forces that erode sanity and defy comprehension.
genreDescriptions.cyberpunk: Dystopian neon-lit cities where hackers and outcasts fight corporate overlords.
genreDescriptions.darkFantasy: Gritty, morally grey world where danger lurks and survival is never guaranteed.
genreDescriptions.folkHorror: Isolated communities, ancient superstitions, and rituals best left forgotten.
genreDescriptions.gothicHorror: Cursed castles, vampires, and dark romance in a world of dread.
genreDescriptions.hardScifi: Realistic science fiction grounded in actual physics and plausible technology.
genreDescriptions.highFantasy: Heroic adventures in a magic-rich world with epic quests and legendary heroes.
genreDescriptions.isekai: Transported to another world — a fish out of water with everything to prove.
genreDescriptions.mythicFantasy: Tales of gods, demigods, and legendary heroes walking among mortals.
genreDescriptions.postApocalyptic: Survival in the ruins of civilization, scavenging and rebuilding.
genreDescriptions.spaceOpera: Galaxy-spanning adventures with starships, alien empires, and cosmic stakes.
genreDescriptions.steampunk: Industrial revolution meets fantastical invention in a world of gears and steam.
genreDescriptions.superhero: Superpowered vigilantes protecting the world from extraordinary threats.
genreDescriptions.survivalHorror: Scarce resources, relentless threats, and the constant fight to stay alive.
genreDescriptions.swordAndSorcery: Low-magic pulp action with mighty warriors and ancient sorceries.
genreDescriptions.urbanFantasy: Hidden magic lurking beneath the surface of modern city life.
genreDescriptions.weirdWest: Six-shooters meet the occult on a lawless supernatural frontier.
genreDescriptions.wuxia: Martial arts mastery, honor codes, and the flow of inner Chi.

wizard.step1Title: Combine two cartridges to initialize world.
